CORE_UTILIZATION.about: Core utilization in percent at floorplan; sets the die size (ORFS variable of the same name).

GPL_TIMING_DRIVEN.about: 1 runs global placement in timing-driven mode (ORFS variable of the same name).

PLACE_DENSITY_LB_ADDON.about: Added to the lowest legal placement density; higher packs cells closer (ORFS variable of the same name).

SETUP_SLACK_MARGIN.about: Setup slack in ns that timing repair aims for instead of zero (ORFS variable of the same name).

SKIP_LAST_GASP.about: 1 skips the last-gasp pass of timing repair (ORFS variable of the same name).

TNS_END_PERCENT.about: Percent of violating endpoints timing repair works on (ORFS variable of the same name).
